awards.title: Main Character
awards.detail: Once sent 10 in a row without anyone answering. It started like this:

awards.title: The Novelist
awards.value_text: 6.6 words per message on average; everyone else: 3.6

receipt.author: Priya
receipt.text:
Ok I have to tell you all about the new dining hall menu because I have Thoughts. First, the stir fry station.
They have changed the sauce. They didn't tell anyone. There was no announcement, no email, no small sign, nothing. It used to be sweet and a little spicy and now it's just brown. Brown is not a flavor. Second, the dessert section now has a "chef's special" every night and tonight it was a pudding that I can only describe as confident. It knew what it was. I respect it but I didn't enjoy it. Third, and this is the important one, they moved the cereal. The cereal has been in the same corner since the day we moved in and now it's next to the salad bar like it's trying to be healthy. It's not healthy. It's cereal. Let it be cereal.
Anyway I wrote all of this in the feedback box and signed it "a concerned resident of floor 4" and I feel like I made a difference today
